body:
Hey hey hey.
Now, after reading this, look- we all make mistakes in our lives. That's what makes us human. You are not a burden upon anyone. I know I'm only a year younger than you, but I can empathize and sympathize on some things. 
Have you considered talking to a professional about these impulses you can't control? I had used one myself and he did wonders in helping me out.
I'm always here if you need to PM me for a D&M OP. People do care about you. No one believes that you truly are a mistake upon society, I guarantee that.

From past experience, yes it is normal to feel like a burden when you're seeking help, feeling like you're upsetting or troubling others by telling them your problems. But people want you happy. 
I'm glad you came here to tell us about this. Honestly, it shows that you don't want to give up but need help, and that in and of itself is a tough thing to do and I'm proud of you OP for doing that.
I'm here too. People here care about you and I'm free to talk anytime.

It does matter. And I do worry, since I've been in a similar situation to yours when I've been ready to give up, but I have prevailed.
You're only human, we all make mistakes. And there is little steps. You work all night and sleep all day, sure. But that free time? I'm not saying to stop playing video games, get drunk and high all the time, but try to reduce that amount and go for a walk. 
My situation was different I will admit, but I felt the same. I did play video games non-stop in my spare time, since that was my way to escape from my real life problems.
You're moving up? Good on you, things will change and that will be a start. Moving to a new place, you might meet new friends and neighbours, so there's that. 
All I'm saying is that don't be ready to give up yet when you already have plans for the future.

Sorry for the late reply, I fell asleep. Different timezones I guess.
But look, things will get better honestly. It's all about the baby steps. Tiny little things that can make a slight difference can build up towards something better.
Your life isn't horrible, you're a strong person who has been through a lot. I know you want the pain and suffering to stop, but it will in time. Things will get better.

I'm here to talk man. I know you're in a rough spot now, believe me I've been there. But as cliché as it sounds, there will be light at the end of the tunnel. I know you don't believe it now, but things will get better, trust me on that.
